name: kov-career-agency-mobile
description: Android and iOS wrapper for the existing KOV Career Agency website.

scripts.build:android:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios:simulator: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
